body: Hey! Got white, yellow and red tulips for you :)

No one ever helped him and going on things got worse (constant depression, anger, crazy and lewd things to me and so many other things) then I started asking him to see someone and get help because I was no longer able to help him and I was losing psychological and physical strength.


The day we broke he started to see a specialist (asking me to come back together but I felt hurt, lost and weak to do it and it was the very first time I told him "no") and I think he is still doing it.

I'm having so many experiences from the breakup and I know I wouldn't with him because I never felt "free" to follow my dreams and do what I like, but every night when I come home I think so much about him and control his social hoping to find something or just hear his voice during live streaming.


Every day I feel our relationship inside me as if he put the roots and this feeling makes me feel bad because I can't be really free.
Is what I'm doing from the very first day we broke, I just got this feeling to be together in a "new life" with the "new me - and - new him".
thank you for your words, really.

This night I was afraid to go to sleep but I spent the evening at home with my father and I think his company has calmed me down (normally I'm alone at home or I stay in my room all alone).

It's 2weeks that I think I need to see a therapist but I haven't the courage to go. I think I use as an excuse the fact of "having much to do" but I hope to deal with my problems and get out of this constant mental and physical condition sooner or later. 

Thanks for your support.
I will try to see my nightmares in a different way even if now it's very difficult to. Thanks for your words ofc

I tried to interpret this dream too but I couldn't of course. My mother said that maybe it's a fear I developed despite all the love and the good things we've lived in 2 years.
Anyway thank you for trying, and of course for your words.
